notes: Standalone example: domain membership and the signed-in users' groups, as text. The built-in sensor also reads each user's directory record (enabled, locked, password age, last logon, manager) and the computer's OU and site.

commands.linux:
# Standalone example: the joined realm and each signed-in user's groups, as text.
realm list 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/^/realm: /'
who | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u | while read u; do echo "$u: $(id -Gn "$u" 2>/dev/null)"; done
commands.darwin:
# Standalone example: an Active Directory binding and the console user's groups, as text.
dsconfigad -show 2>/dev/null | grep 'Active Directory Domain' | sed 's/^ *//'
u=$(stat -f%Su /dev/console); echo "$u: $(id -Gn "$u")"
